Texas Workforce Commission connects people with careers across the state. While we are based in Austin on the north lawn of the Texas State Capitol, we have offices statewide. This position is located at 101 E. 15th Street, Austin, Texas, in the Division of Information Innovation & Insight (I/3).

TWC is not considering applications from individuals who require sponsorship for an employment visa, including those with H1B visas or those currently on student or postgraduate visas.

You must be a Texas resident to work for the Texas Workforce Commission or willing to relocate to Texas.

Who You Are

We are looking for a creative and experienced Data Analyst IV to join the ETL team in TWC’s Division of Information Innovation and Insight (I|3). The division supports the agency’s mission by leveraging data to improve decision-making and service efficiency. That is, we leverage Data for Prosperity.

The data analyst will support I|3’s mission to extract, transform, and load data for reporting to better serve the employers, individuals, families, and communities of Texas. Candidates must be enthusiastic about working collaboratively with teammates, TWC staff, and other state agency staff to deliver accurate information on deadline to a wide variety of stakeholders, including other State Agencies and Local Workforce Development Areas (LWDA).
Candidates will have the opportunity to apply their mindset to develop, maintain, and improve current ETL processes, and ultimately make a difference in the lives of Texans.

The Data Analyst IV performs complex (journey-level) data analysis and data research. Works under general supervision, with moderate latitude for the use of initiative and independent judgment.

Consult with internal and external customers to identify user needs for business requirements and data sources.

Three years of full-time experience in data science, business analytics, computer science, computer information systems, management information systems, accounting, finance, mathematics, statistics, economics, or a related field.

Three years of full-time experience converting legacy ETL solutions to contemporary ETL implementations.
Three years of full-time experience developing and reverse engineering SQL and PL/SQL code bases.
Three years of full-time experience with large data sets.
Three years of full-time experience coding within Oracle database environments.
Three years of full-time experience creating Informatica Cloud Services (IICS) taskflows.

Strong ability to present thoughts, observations, and findings clearly and concisely in written and oral forms.

MP Materials (NYSE: MP) is rebuilding American industrial capability for a new era of autonomy, robotics, and electrification.

We are the only U.S. company with a fully integrated rare earth supply chain—from mining and refining to advanced metal and magnet manufacturing. Our products include both the critical materials used to make permanent magnets and the finished magnets themselves—enabling next-generation technologies in robotics, automation, aerospace, transportation, defense, and energy systems. We hire ambitious, mission-driven people who want to tackle complex challenges and shape the future of strategic industries. Our culture is rooted in teamwork, resiliency, and integrity, with a deep commitment to operational excellence and national purpose. MP is rapidly evolving from a materials producer into a leading U.S. manufacturer—and our people are driving that transformation.

This position will possess a unique view of the business and support manufacturing, engineering, finance, and other functional teams in developing and analyzing operational performance, resource allocation, and future planning. Develop advanced reports, dashboards, and visualizations to monitor manufacturing performance, operational efficiency, and financial KPIs.
Perform in-depth statistical and trend analysis on production, inventory, and cost data to identify opportunities for process optimization and cost reduction.
Interpret complex datasets and present actionable insights with clear distinction between data-driven facts and business recommendations.
Support enterprise-wide analytics initiatives, including predictive modeling and process optimization projects.
Work with engineering teams to gather and analyze process data in the context of underlying physical parameters, helping drive fundamental understanding of process performance on a first principles basis.

Collaborate with business stakeholders to understand analytical needs.
Develop and maintain dashboards, weekly manager reports, and recurring analysis.
Develop statistical analysis using large disparate data sources to form new insights and support data-driven decision processes.
Provide weekly and monthly reports and analyses for senior leaders.
Manage aspects of the analytical architecture and collection of manufacturing data.
Other duties as assigned.

Bachelor’s degree in Data Analytics, Industrial Engineering, Finance, Computer Science, or related field.
3+ years of experience in a manufacturing environment or with manufacturing data analytics; public company experience is a plus.
Strong understanding of manufacturing processes, operational KPIs, and cost structures.
Proficiency in data analysis tools and techniques, including advanced SQL, Power BI, Python, KNIME or similar tools preferred.
Ability to work with large, complex datasets from multiple sources and deliver clear, actionable insights.

Ability to work with all levels within the organization, including senior management.
Ability to work with internal customers and external agencies for compliance and controls.
